component-o.description-s: KK 254 breakaway header, vertical, 2 circuits, 2.54 mm, tin. As a power header: 1 V, 2 GND; as an LED link: 1 LED drive (anode), 2 return (cathode, ground).

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: Molex 26950000-SD (2695 / 22-01-3027): 2-circuit housing 5.64 x 4.82 x 12.7 mm seated on the header's 2.54 mm base; two 22 AWG wires (1.57 mm insulation) 15 mm up

connector-o.board_area_note_s: bounding rect of courtyard and mate keepout
connector-o.fields_source_s: current: KK 254 4.0 A per contact with 22 AWG on 2759 terminals (Nexar maker spec), voltage 250 V; current 4.0 A per contact: Molex KK 254 system spec (22-28-4020-system-spec.pdf) 'Current: 4.0A' (22 AWG 4.00 A, 24 AWG 3.75 A); the header's own rating, a brass-terminal harness is 2.5 A

contact_resistance_source-o.document-s: Molex KK 254 catalog MX01 C-119, series 42375
contact_resistance_source-o.rating-s: 20 milliohm maximum per mated contact, matched KK system; not a bare-pin resistance measurement

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
